name: Koga Nazuna
source:
Nazuna is a college student who looks exactly like the avatar of the nekama that the protagonist had a crush on.

She has a sociable personality and a wide face, and often shows up at various events.

[From [url=https://en.sushi-soft.com/sutekano]Official website[/url]]
